server.port.description: TCP port on which the LCDd server listens for client connections.

server.host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to. Mapped to the 'Bind' directive in LCDd.conf.

server.driver.description: Name of the LCD driver to load (e.g., 'hd44780', 'IOWarrior', 'sure_elec'). Note: The config directive is 'Driver', not 'Protocol'. The template incorrectly used 'Protocol' as the key name in the config, which is not a valid LCDd directive. Replaced with 'Driver'. The values_schema enum remains valid as it lists driver names.

server.device.description: Path to the physical LCD device (e.g., /dev/lcd0, /dev/usb/lcd).

server.foreground.description: Run LCDd in the foreground. Overrides the -f command line option.

server.wait_time.description: Time in seconds to pause at each screen. Overrides the -w command line option.

server.report_to_syslog.description: Report messages to syslog (1) or stdout (0). Overrides the -s command line option.

server.report_level.description: Reporting level (0-5). Overrides the -r command line option.

server.user.description: Run as user user. Overrides the -u command line option.

drivers.description: List of driver-specific configuration sections. Each element defines options for one driver.

clients.description: List of client definitions that may connect to LCDd. Each defines permissions and allowed screens.
